directconnect.DescribeConnections.doc: Displays the specified connection or all connections in this Region.

item.doc: Information about an Direct Connect connection.

ownerAccount.doc: The ID of the Amazon Web Services account that owns the connection.

connectionState.doc: The state of the connection. The following are the possible values: ordering : The initial state of a hosted connection provisioned on an interconnect. The connection stays in the ordering state until the owner of the hosted connection confirms or declines the connection order. requested : The initial state of a standard connection. The connection stays in the requested state until the Letter of Authorization (LOA) is sent to the customer. pending : The connection has been approved and is being…

region.doc: The Amazon Web Services Region where the connection is located.

partnerName.doc: The name of the Direct Connect service provider associated with the connection.

loaIssueTime.doc: The time of the most recent call to DescribeLoa for this connection.

awsDevice.doc: The Direct Connect endpoint on which the physical connection terminates.

jumboFrameCapable.doc: Indicates whether jumbo frames are supported.

awsDeviceV2.doc: The Direct Connect endpoint that terminates the physical connection.

awsLogicalDeviceId.doc: The Direct Connect endpoint that terminates the logical connection. This device might be different than the device that terminates the physical connection.

hasLogicalRedundancy.doc: Indicates whether the connection supports a secondary BGP peer in the same address family (IPv4/IPv6).

tags.doc: The tags associated with the connection.

providerName.doc: The name of the service provider associated with the connection.

macSecCapable.doc: Indicates whether the connection supports MAC Security (MACsec).

portEncryptionStatus.doc: The MAC Security (MACsec) port link status of the connection. The valid values are Encryption Up , which means that there is an active Connection Key Name, or Encryption Down .

encryptionMode.doc: The MAC Security (MACsec) connection encryption mode. The valid values are no_encrypt , should_encrypt , and must_encrypt .

macSecKeys.doc: The MAC Security (MACsec) security keys associated with the connection.

item.doc: Information about the MAC Security (MACsec) secret key.

secretARN.doc: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the MAC Security (MACsec) secret key.

ckn.doc: The Connection Key Name (CKN) for the MAC Security secret key.

state.doc: The state of the MAC Security (MACsec) secret key. The possible values are: associating : The MAC Security (MACsec) secret key is being validated and not yet associated with the connection or LAG. associated : The MAC Security (MACsec) secret key is validated and associated with the connection or LAG. disassociating : The MAC Security (MACsec) secret key is being disassociated from the connection or LAG disassociated : The MAC Security (MACsec) secret key is no longer associated with the connec…

startOn.doc: The date that the MAC Security (MACsec) secret key takes effect. The value is displayed in UTC format.
